description: California payroll figures for 2026: unemployment insurance (UI), employment training tax (ETT) and state disability insurance (SDI). Personal income tax withholding needs the 2026 California Employer's Guide (DE 44), not yet supplied.

sources.title: EDD, Tax Rates, Wage Limits, and Value of Meals and Lodging (DE 3395)

incomeTaxWithholding.note: Needs the 2026 California Employer's Guide (DE 44): Method B tables, low-income exemption, standard deduction, estimated deduction and exemption allowance tables, and supplemental rates.

unemployment.note: The employer's own rate comes from its EDD rate notice (entered in Payroll > Setup); new employers pay 3.4% for up to 3 years.

stateDisabilityInsurance.note: No SDI taxable wage limit since January 1, 2024.

lodging.note: 66.67% of ordinary rental value, within these limits; non-maritime employees.

incomeTax.note: Pay for services is subject to state withholding. Which pre-tax deductions and company contributions reduce or add to withholding wages is not in the supplied documents; paychecks with them are refused until sourced.

unemployment.note: Pay for services is subject to unemployment tax. How pre-tax deductions, tips, reimbursements and company contributions are treated is not in the supplied documents; paychecks with them are refused until sourced.

ownerApproval.scope: Figures checked as copied from the supplied documents, for building and testing the tax calculations. Not a professional review: reviewedBy stays null until a CPA or payroll specialist signs off, which is required before real paychecks.

note: Approved by the product owner for building (see ownerApproval); awaiting professional review.
